summary: The committee reviewed the district's Multi-Tiered System of Supports framework [16:28], received high school operational updates [27:18], and held an extensive discussion on proposed school calendar options and holiday observances following family survey feedback [31:45], [46:22]. Administrators presented school improvement plans and analyzed district MCAS performance data, detailing overall achievement alongside persistent demographic gaps [2:02:55], [2:31:02], [2:51:35]. During public comment, community members spoke on calendar closures, child care impacts, and racial equity concerns [3:31:42], [3:40:06], [4:07:01]. Finally, the committee voted to approve the consent agenda [4:26:50] and approved moving a policy regarding property oversight to the recreation department [4:31:07].
